acceptedAnswer.text: Getting a storm damage inspection soon after a storm in the DFW area is crucial because damage can worsen over time, leading to more costly repairs. Also, many insurance policies have time limits for filing claims. Identifying and addressing issues promptly helps prevent secondary damage like leaks or mold, which may not be covered if reported too late.
